articles.summary: Bank of Marin Bancorp (Nasdaq: BMRC) will present its third quarter earnings call via webcast on Monday, October 26, 2026, at 8:30 a.m. PT/11:30 a.m. ET. All interested parties are invited to listen to President and Chief Executive Officer Tim Myers and Executive Vice President and Chief Financial Officer Dave Bonaccorso discuss the Company's fiscal third quarter, which ended September 30, 2026. Investors will have the opportunity to listen to the webcast online through Bank of Marin’s website at www.bankofmarin.com under “Investor Relations.” To listen to the webcast live, please log on at least 15 minutes before the call to register and install any necessary audio software. For those who cannot listen to the live broadcast, a replay will be available at the same website location shortly after the call. articles.title: Bank of Marin Bancorp to Webcast Q3 Earnings on Monday, October 26, 2026, at 8:30 a.m. PT

articles.summary: Bank of Marin Bancorp, "Bancorp" (Nasdaq: BMRC), parent company of Bank of Marin, "Bank," completed another quarter of improved financial performance, reflecting continued enhanced profitability and overall balance sheet strength. This performance was supported by progress across key financial and operating priorities: Increased earnings per share, pre-tax pre-provision net income, and return on average tangible common equity Expanded net interest margin from higher loan yields and reduced deposit costs, and grew both total deposits and noninterest-bearing deposits Loan growth from organic originations supplemented by a loan pool purchase Core non-interest income growth Prudent expense management BMRC reports net income of $9.9 million for the third quarter of 2026. This compares to net income of $9.2 million for the second quarter of 2026 and net income of $7.5 million for the third quarter of 2025.
